note: Montserrat: nationals of the countries listed (the EU's but Croatia's) stay up to 6 months without a visa; everyone else may apply online for an electronic visa (valid a year, multiple entries). Holders of a UK, US, Canadian or EU visa need none (not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy (the territory's immigration pages publish no list this client can read). Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Government's own online visa site, whose lists of the countries needing and not needing a visa cover every nationality: every passport held as free is on the not-required list (Croatia isn't); the site gives no length of stay, so the 6 months stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policies of British Overseas Territories
sources.said: Montserrat – A visa-free stay of 6 months is granted to nationals of all European Union countries (except Croatia ), Andorra , Antigua and Barbuda , Argentina , Australia , Bahamas , Bangladesh , Barbados , Belize , Botswana , Brazil , Brunei , Cameroon , Canada , Chile , Costa Rica , Dominica , Dominican Republic , East Timor , Eswatini , Fiji , Gambia , Ghana , Grenada , Guatemala , Guyana , Haiti , Honduras , Hong Kong , Iceland , India , Israel , Jamaica , Japan , Kenya , Kiribati , Lesotho , Liechtenstein , Macao , Malawi , Malaysia , Maldives , Marshall Islands , Mauritius , Mexico , Micronesia , Monaco , Myanmar , Namibia , Nauru , New Zealand , Nicaragua , Nigeria , Norway , Pakistan , Palau , Panama , Papua New Guinea , Paraguay , Rwanda , Saint Kitts and Nevis , Saint Lucia , Saint Vincent and the Grenadines , Samoa , San Marino , Seychelles , Sierra Leone , Singapore , Solomon Islands , South Africa , South Korea , Sri Lanka , Suriname , Switzerland , Taiwan , Tanzania , Tonga , Trinidad and Tobago , Tuvalu , Uganda , United Kingdom , United States , Uruguay , Vanuatu , Vatican City , Western Sahara , Zambia and Zimbabwe . ... Other travellers may apply online for an electronic visa, which is valid for 1 year and may be used for multiple entries.

sources.said: This is a list of Countries that do not require a visa to travel to Montserrat. American Samoa Andorra Anguilla Antarctica Antigua and Barbuda Argentina Aruba Australia Austria Bahamas Bangladesh Barbados Belgium Belize ... Western Sahara Zambia Zimbabwe

sources.title: Government of Montserrat Online Visa Application: FAQs
sources.said: If you are a national of country listed under the visa required list , then you require a visa to travel to Montserrat. If however, your are a national of a country listed under the visa not required list , then you don't need a visa to travel to Montserrat.
